_note: Inputs for backend/src/scripts/ironwoodEnergy.ts. Every value carries its source, date and working.

phase1_mw.method: The case gives a 480 MW initial substation; the real Upper Mount Bethel filings show a 480 MW on-site substation.

full_build_mw.method: The case gives up to 2,000 MW at full build; the real MOU targets 2 gigawatts.

load_factor.method: The campus is taken to draw its full peak in every hour, the same convention leepr's cost runs use, so the two sets of figures agree. A real campus averages somewhat less, which would scale every annual figure down in proportion.

discount_rate.method: KGE's 10% investment threshold, from the case.

gas_capex_usd_per_kw.method: Onsite gas is priced as a reciprocating engine plant, the technology data centers buy for islanded supply (Wärtsilä's 412 MW, 40-engine order for an Ohio hyperscale campus, Power Engineering 16 Apr 2026). EIA AEO2020 capital cost report, Case 4, four 5.6 MW engines: $1,810/kW in 2019 dollars, the latest EIA engine case. Low $1,700/kW is the Wärtsilä 18V50SG screening cost in NYISO's 2025-2029 demand curve reset (Burns & McDonnell, Dec 2023). High $2,400/kW is the market quote S&P Global reported for new gas plants in May 2025.

gas_heat_rate_btu_per_kwh.method: EIA AEO2020 Case 4 reciprocating engines, 8,295 Btu/kWh. NYISO's Wärtsilä 18V50SG screening figure agrees at 8,290 Btu/kWh HHV.

gas_plant_life_years.method: Recovered over the customer's 20-year power agreement rather than Lazard's 30-year plant life, because the plant exists to serve that contract.

gas_redundancy_factor.unit: installed MW per MW of load
gas_redundancy_factor.method: An islanded campus needs spare engines so one can be down for maintenance or a fault without dropping load. 15% spare capacity is an assumption; no published standard was found.

gas_capacity_factor.method: Delivered energy per kW of campus load, equal to the load factor.

gas_price_usd_per_mmbtu.method: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook (6 Oct 2026) Henry Hub forecast for 2026, $3.48/MMBtu. Low is the 2027 forecast, $3.16. High is the price Pennsylvania industrial users paid in 2024, $9.19/Mcf (EIA), divided by 1.037 MMBtu per Mcf = $8.86/MMBtu. A plant tapping an interstate pipeline in eastern Pennsylvania would pay between the two.

gas_co2_lb_per_mmbtu.method: EIA carbon dioxide emissions coefficient for natural gas, 116.65 lb CO2/MMBtu. EPA's 2025 factor (53.06 kg = 117.0 lb) agrees.

gas_years_to_power.method: Wärtsilä's 412 MW engine order for an Ohio data center, placed in April 2026, targets commercial operation in early 2028, about two years. Value adds half a year for Pennsylvania air permitting. Low 2 years is that Ohio schedule. High 5 years is the average wait for a large gas turbine in 2025 (Wood Mackenzie via Utility Dive, 24 Feb 2026), the fallback if engines are not used.

battery_capex_usd_per_kwh.method: NREL, Cost Projections for Utility-Scale Battery Storage: 2025 Update, 4-hour system in 2024: $334/kWh (2024$). Low is NREL's 2030 low projection, $207/kWh. High is the top of Lazard LCOS 2026's initial capital range, $365/kWh.

battery_fixed_om_share.method: NREL ATB 2024: fixed O&M at 2.5% of capital cost per year.
